entities.name: André Langevin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: André Langevin, OC was a Canadian writer and journalist. He is best known for his Prix du Cercle du livre de France-winning novels Évadé de la nuit (1951) and Poussière sur la ville (1953); Poussière sur la ville was also published in English as Dust Over the City (1955), and adapted by Arthur Lamothe as the theatrical film Dust from Underground in 1968.
